items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@'s deep voice booms through the caverns.*#WHITE#
This is my domain, and I do not take kindly to intruders. What is your purpose here?
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@的低沉嗓音在山洞里发出隆隆的回响*#WHITE#
这里是我的地盘，我会毫不客气地对付任何入侵者，你到这里想干什么？

items.source: I am here to kill you and take your treasures! Die, damned fish!
items.target: 我是来杀死你然后抢夺你的财宝的，死吧，该死的杂鱼！

items.source: DIE!
items.target: 去死！

items.source: I did not mean to intrude. I shall leave now.
items.target: 我无意闯入这里，我会离开的。

items.source:
Wait! You seem to be worthy, so let me tell you a story.
During the Age of Pyre the world was sundered by the last effects of the Spellblaze. A part of the continental shelf of Maj'Eyal was torn apart and thrown into the sea.
The Naloren Elves perished... or so the world thinks. Some of them survived; using ancient Sher'Tul magic they had kept for themselves, they transformed to live underwater.
They are now called the nagas. They live deep in the ocean between Maj'Eyal and the Far East.
One of them, Slasul, rebelled against his order and decided he wanted the world for himself, both underwater and above. He found an ancient temple, probably a Sher'Tul remain, called the Temple of Creation.
He believes he can use it to #{italic}#improve#{normal}# nagas.
But he has become mad and now looks upon all other intelligent water life as a threat, and that includes myself.
I cannot leave this sanctuary, but perhaps you could help me?
After all, it would be an act of mercy to end his madness.
items.target:
等下！你看上去有点价值，让我告诉你一个故事。
在烈火纪，世界被魔法大爆炸的余波撕裂，马基·埃亚尔的一部分大陆架被撕裂出去漂向了海洋。
纳鲁精灵种族灭亡了……至少世界上的人都这么认为。事实上他们之中的一些人使用古代夏·图尔的魔法存活了下来，他们转而在水下生活。
他们现在被称为娜迦，他们生活在马基·埃亚尔和远东大陆之间的海洋深处。
他们中的一个，萨拉苏尔，违抗了他的使命，妄图控制整个水上和水下世界，他发现了一个有可能残留有夏·图尔遗迹的古代神庙，叫做造物者神庙。
他相信可以利用它来#{italic}#进化#{normal}#娜迦。
但是他陷入了疯狂，把一切水下智慧生物都视为对他的威胁，包括我自己。
我不能离开这个圣所，但是也许你能帮我结果了他？
毕竟，算是对他疯狂的一种宽恕吧。

items.source: I would still rather kill you and take your treasure!
items.target: 我还是要杀了你，夺取你的财宝！

items.source: I shall do as you say, but how do I find him?
items.target: 我会照着你的话去做，但是去哪儿找他呢？

items.source: That seems... unwise. My apologies, but I must refuse.
items.target: 这似乎不是明智之举，很抱歉，我必须拒绝。

items.source: I can open a portal to his lair, far away in the western sea, but be warned: this is one-way only. I cannot bring you back. You will have to find your own way.
items.target: 我可以为你打开一道传送门，抵达他在西部海洋的巢穴，不过我提醒你：传送是单程的，我没法带你回来，你必须自己去想办法找到返回的路。

items.source: I will.
items.target: 好的。

items.source: This is a death trap! Goodbye.
items.target: 这是个陷阱！再见！

items.source: Yes?
items.target: 嗯？

items.source: [attack]
items.target: [攻击]

items.source: TREACHERY!
items.target: 背叛者！

items.source: I want your treasures, water beast!
items.target: 我需要你的财宝，水下怪物！

items.source: Oh, is that so? Well, COME GET THEM!
items.target: 哦，你确定？好啊，来拿啊！

items.source: I spoke with Slasul, and he did not seem hostile, or mad.
items.target: 我询问过萨拉苏尔，他貌似不是个坏人，也没疯。

items.source: Farewell, dragon.
items.target: 告辞了，巨龙。

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@ roars!*#WHITE# You listen to the lies of this mad naga!
You are corrupted! TAINTED!
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@ 发出了怒吼！*#WHITE# 你居然听信这个疯子娜迦的谎言！
你也堕落了！

items.source: DO NOT MEDDLE IN THE AFFAIRS OF DRAGONS!
items.target: 不要管巨龙的闲事！

items.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*Shake your head.*#LAST#He swayed my mind! Please, I am not your enemy.
items.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*你摇摇头。*#LAST#好吧，我被他骗了，我不是你的敌人。

items.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@ calms down!*#WHITE# Very well; he is indeed a trickster.  Now go finish your task, or do not come back!
items.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*@npcname@ 冷静了下来！*#WHITE# 好吧，他的确是个骗子，那现在去完成你的任务吧，要不然就不要回来了！

items.source: Thank you, mighty one.
items.target: 谢谢你，强大的巨龙。

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a Human clothed in black robes. He seems to be ignoring you.*#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You stand inside some kind of summoning circle, which prevents you from moving.*#WHITE#
Oh yes! YES, one more for my collection. My collection, yes. A powerful one indeed!
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个穿着黑色长袍的人类，他目前似乎无视了你。*#WHITE#
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你站在一个召唤法阵里，没法移动。*#WHITE#
啊，对！好！又一件我的收藏品，没错，的确是很强力的一个！

items.source: [listen]
items.target: [听他说话]

items.source:
A powerful tool against my enemies. Yes, yes. They all hate me, but I will show them my power!
I will show them! SHOW THEM!
items.target:
一个对抗敌人的强力工具，对，没错，他们都仇恨我，我要让他们尝尝我的厉害！
给他们点颜色看看！等着瞧！

items.source: I am not a tool! RELEASE ME!
items.target: 我不是你的工具！放开我！

items.source:
You cannot talk. You cannot talk! You are a slave, a tool!
You are mine! Be quiet!
#LIGHT_GREEN#*As his mind drifts off you notice part of the summoning circle is fading. You can probably escape!*#WHITE#
items.target:
你不可能说话，你不可能说话的啊！你是一个奴隶，一件工具！
你是我的，安静点！
#LIGHT_GREEN#*当他的注意力开始分散时，你注意到召唤法阵正在消失，你可以逃跑了！*#WHITE#

items.source: [attack]
items.target: [攻击]

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He falls to his knees.*#WHITE#
Please spare me! I am pitiful. I will not stop you. Let me leave!
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他跪了下来*#WHITE#
饶恕我吧，饶了我这个可怜的人，我不会再阻止你了，让我走吧！

items.source: No!
items.target: 不行！

items.source:
But, but, you were my... you...
You need me! What do you think you will do on the surface? Everything you will meet will try to destroy you.
You are strong but you cannot resist them all!
items.target:
但……但……你是我的……你……
你还需要我！你想你到外面会怎么样？所有你见到的东西都会想摧毁你。
你虽然很强，但是你不可能对抗所有人！

items.source: So what do you propose?
items.target: 那你的建议呢？

items.source: [kill him]
items.target: [杀了他]

items.source: ARRGGggg... You are alone! You will be destroyed!
items.target: 啊啊啊啊噶……你孤身一人！注定走向毁灭！

items.source:
I can give you a cloak that will conceal your true nature!
With it all people will see when they look at you is a normal average Human. You can go about your business.
Please!
items.target:
我可以给你一件斗篷，让别人认不出你的本来面目。
穿着它你的外形看上去就会像一个普通人一样，不会引起别人的注意，这样你就可以干任何你想干的事了。
求求你！

items.source: Thanks for the information. Now you may die. [kill him]
items.target: 谢谢你的帮忙，现在你可以死了。[杀了他]

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*A beautiful Elven woman in golden robes stands before you, facing an orc clad in mail.*#WHITE#
Fillarel: "Abandon this fight, orc! You cannot win: I stand with the power of the Sun and the shadows of the Moons."
Krogar: "Ha! It's only been one hour and you already look tired, my 'lady'."
#LIGHT_GREEN#*As you enter the room they notice you.*#WHITE#
Fillarel: "You! @playerdescriptor.race@! Help me defeat this monster or begone!"
Krogar: "Ah, looking for help? Bah. @playerdescriptor.race@, kill this wench for me and I shall reward you!"
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*一个穿着金色长袍的美丽精灵女子站在你面前，另一边是穿着锁甲的兽人。*#WHITE#
菲拉瑞尔：“投降吧，兽人！你不会赢的，太阳的伟力、月亮的暗影与我同在。”
克罗格： “哈！才过了一个小时而已，你看上去都很疲惫了，‘女士’。”
#LIGHT_GREEN#*当你进入房间时他们注意到了你*#WHITE#
菲拉瑞尔： “你！ @playerdescriptor.race@!帮我干掉这只怪物，不然就快离开！”
克罗格： “哦？想找人帮忙？呸，@playerdescriptor.race@，给我干掉这个臭婊子，我会报答你的！”

items.source: [attack Krogar]
items.target: [攻击克罗格]

items.source: Thank you, @playername@. I hate to admit it, but you saved my life.
items.target: 谢谢你，@playername@。不得不承认，你救了我的命。

items.source: At your service. But may I ask what you were doing in this dark place?
items.target: 我乐意效劳，但你能告诉我你在这个黑暗的地方干什么吗？

items.source: At your service. I have been gone for months, but I can feel it, at last this is my homeland!
items.target: 我乐意效劳。我已经离开几个月了，不过我能够感觉到，这里就是我的故乡！

items.source:
I am an Anorithil, a mage of the Sun and Moons; we fight all that is evil. I was with a group of Sun Paladins; we came from the Gates of Morning to the east.
My companions were... were slaughtered by orcs, and I nearly died as well. Thank you again for your help.
items.target:
我是借用太阳和月亮力量的星月术士，来自东面的晨曦之门，同太阳骑士一起对抗邪恶。
我的伙伴们…都被兽人杀死了，我也差点丧命，再次感谢你的帮助。

items.source: It was my pleasure. But may I ask a favor myself? I am not from these lands. I used a farportal guarded by orcs deep below the Iron Throne and was brought here.
items.target: 我的荣幸，不过我有个请求。我其实不是这个大陆的人，使用了钢铁王座地下深处，被兽人保护的远古传送门，然后就到了这里。

items.source:
Yes, I noticed you were not from here. Your only hope is the Gates of Morning, the last bastion of freedom in this orc territory. When you leave the caves, head southeast; you cannot miss it.
Tell High Sun Paladin Aeryn that you met me. I'll send word to let you pass.
items.target:
是的，我也注意到了你不是这里的人，晨曦之门，这座兽人领地中仅存的自由基地，将是你的唯一希望。你离开洞穴，往东南方走就可以到达那里。
告诉高阶太阳骑士艾琳你碰到我的事，我会留下口信让他们给你放行。

items.source: Thank you, I will talk with Aeryn.
items.target: 谢谢你，我会找艾琳谈谈的。

items.source:
Gone? Wait, this face.. you are @playername@! We thought you died in the naga portal explosion!
Thanks to your courage the Gates of Morning still stand.
You should go there at once.
items.target:
离开了？等一下，这张脸……你是 @playername@！我们都以为你在娜迦传送门爆炸的时候死了！
因你的壮举，晨曦之门依然屹立不倒。
你应该马上去那里。

items.source: Sadly I am the bringer of bad news, the orcs are planning something. Good luck, my lady.
items.target: 恐怕我带来了一些坏消息，兽人正筹划着什么阴谋，祝你好运，女士。

items.source: @playerdescriptor.race@, you have helped me kill the Elf-wench. The Orc Pride thanks you... for now
items.target: @playerdescriptor.race@，你帮我干掉了那个精灵臭婊子，现在兽人部落很感谢你。

items.source: I hate Elves anyway...
items.target: 我讨厌精灵……
